predeclared_native_acceptance: Guarded session-0 SSH under the host-wide mutex preserves GUI PID 13340, seals immutable sources and raw outputs, completes four native CLI steps, and returns zero conversion errors with classified warnings.
Exact source-row import/export identity across 13 populated tables; nonempty native report and 72 aligned half-hour bins with NREP=32.

The aggregate log's exposed group contains exactly three missions at hour 8; each succeeds and completes at hour 10. Aggregate reports reconcile six aircraft mission-operation hours per replication and three aircraft ready at hour 36, with no failure, repair, shortage or stock demand.

Because the aggregate log may omit replication groups, a separately predeclared 32-seed one-replication matrix is required to observe all 32 timelines; every seed must show the same three-at-8, three-at-10 pattern and matching reports. The seed-1 timeline may be compared with the aggregate log only as an observed same-seed check.
A separate read-only reviewer replays source delta, raw seals, event groups and ledgers without importing author validation.
